definitions.explanation: Beans that have not been cooked, roasted, or otherwise processed. Used when distinguishing raw beans from their prepared forms.

definitions.gloss: green coffee beans; unroasted coffee beans
definitions.explanation: Coffee beans in their raw, unroasted state. A term commonly used in the specialty coffee world, where enthusiasts purchase green beans and roast them at home.

examples.japanese: {生豆|なままめ}は{十分|じゅうぶん}に{加熱|かねつ}してから{食|た}べてください。
examples.english: Please cook raw beans thoroughly before eating.

examples.japanese: {大豆|だいず}は{生豆|なままめ}のまま{食|た}べると{消化|しょうか}に{悪|わる}い。
examples.english: Eating soybeans raw is bad for digestion.

examples.japanese: {生豆|なままめ}は{緑色|みどりいろ}をしている。
examples.english: Green coffee beans are green in color.

examples.japanese: {自家|じか}{焙煎|ばいせん}をするために、{生豆|なままめ}を{通販|つうはん}で{取|と}り{寄|よ}せた。
examples.english: I ordered green coffee beans online to do my own home roasting.

examples.japanese: この{店|みせ}では{世界|せかい}{各地|かくち}の{生豆|なままめ}を{量|はか}り{売|う}りしている。
examples.english: This shop sells green coffee beans from around the world by weight.

examples.japanese: {生豆|なままめ}の{品質|ひんしつ}が{焙煎後|ばいせんご}の{味|あじ}を{大|おお}きく{左右|さゆう}する。
examples.english: The quality of the green beans greatly affects the taste after roasting.

notes:
Composed of {生|なま} (raw, unprocessed) and {豆|まめ} (beans). The word has two distinct usage domains: general cooking (raw beans of any kind) and specialty coffee (unroasted coffee beans).

In the coffee context, {生豆|なままめ} refers to the green, unroasted beans that are the starting material for roasting. The specialty coffee boom in Japan has made this sense increasingly common. Coffee enthusiasts and roasters use the term frequently when discussing bean origins, processing methods, and quality.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {生豆|なままめ}を{焙煎|ばいせん}する: to roast green coffee beans
- {生豆|なままめ}の{産地|さんち}: origin of green beans
- {生豆|なままめ}を{選|えら}ぶ: to select green beans
- {生豆|なままめ}の{状態|じょうたい}: condition of raw/green beans

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {煎|い}り{豆|まめ}: roasted beans — beans that have been dry-roasted
- {乾燥|かんそう}{豆|まめ}: dried beans — beans preserved by drying, but not necessarily raw
- {焙煎豆|ばいせんまめ}: roasted coffee beans — the result after green beans are roasted
